## About Mukul Bushi Reddy M
Mukul Bushi Reddy M is a Frontend Developer specializing in Angular, TypeScript, React, Spring Boot, AI Application Integration, and Modern Motion UI/UX.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Frontend Frameworks**: Angular, TypeScript, React 19, RxJS, Next.js, Vite
- **UI & Motion Design**: Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, GSAP, Glassmorphism, 3D CSS Transforms, shadcn/ui
- **Backend & DevOps**: Spring Boot, REST APIs, Kotlin, SQL, Firebase, Docker, Cloudflare Pages, Git
- **AI & Telemetry Integration**: Gemini Live WebSocket API, Ollama, Client-Side Media Processing, Live GPS Telemetry Systems
